qualification_scope: Owner-requested full progressive-context charging batch: one explicit Active/Inactive setting, four independent charger states, ordinary configuration Save, bounded guest duration and measured kWh/budget goals, integrated SoC/Ready By, native adjustable setpoint and applicable configured constraints, mixed four-charger/four-asset upgrade, degraded optional sources, command feedback and recovery. Preserve existing architecture, identities, settings/history and all unchanged functionality. Exact candidate dev/main, installed HA, browser and artifact gates.
limitations: Wessels live HA configuration/actual source availability, Safari/iPad and physical handover acceptance are separate. Actual private site values for charging objectives, phase/voltage conversion and usable battery capacity/efficiency must be supplied where needed; do not guess. No STABLE or full field acceptance; immutable v0.1.14 is rollback.
